This solution is architected to follow the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (SRG) for hosting Impact Level (IL) 4 and 5 workloads in the cloud. Using the Compliant Framework solution, you are able to quickly deploy an architecture baseline that accommodates U.S. federal and Department of Defense (DoD) requirements to rapidly achieve Authority to Operate (ATO). In addition, the Compliant Framework solution is also architected to support Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) readiness.
